test_case_name: Search for information using the desktop search bar on the FAQ page

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field on the FAQ page
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search on the FAQ page
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the entered query

test_case_name: Reset the desktop search input on the FAQ page

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field on the FAQ page
Click the 'btn-reset-search' button to clear the search input on the FAQ page
And then check that the search input field is cleared

test_case_name: Login as guest user on the FAQ page with remember me option

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field on the FAQ page
Type $password into the 'Password' input field on the FAQ page
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox on the FAQ page
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form on the FAQ page
And then check that the user is logged in and the session is maintained

test_case_name: Login as guest user on the FAQ page without remember me option

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field on the FAQ page
Type $password into the 'Password' input field on the FAQ page
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form on the FAQ page
And then check that the user is logged in without the session being maintained
